personagent_url.description: Base URL of the persona agent, such as http://127.0.0.1:8080; the plugin posts to /v1/events and pulls /v1/outbox under it. Must be loopback, or HTTPS with connector_token set; plain HTTP to any other host (e.g. another container) is refused and logged as 'refusing unsafe personagent_url'.

connector_token.description: Shared secret used for the bearer header and replay-resistant HMAC envelope. It must match the agent's CONNECTOR_TOKEN. A non-empty value is required for every off-host endpoint.

timeout_s.description: HTTP timeout in seconds for one agent round-trip. A turn includes a short debounce and every model call and retry, so keep this generous: above LLM_TIMEOUT_S x (1 + LLM_MAX_RETRIES) on the agent.

excluded_platforms.description: Platform adapter names that must NOT be forwarded. To carry QQ (the supported path), remove aiocqhttp from this list and set CONNECTOR_QQ_PLATFORMS=aiocqhttp on the agent so QQ ids stay spelled the way every store on disk already spells them. Keep aiocqhttp here only while NapCat still feeds the agent directly through the deprecated /v1/onebot, otherwise QQ messages would be handled twice.

groups.description: Group IDs to forward. Default-deny: an empty list forwards no groups. "*" forwards every group, and the agent's ACCESS_GROUPS decides alone (a platform other than QQ with no entries there is refused).

dm_users.description: Sender IDs whose direct messages are forwarded. Default-deny: an empty list forwards no DMs. "*" forwards every DM, and the agent's ACCESS_DM_USERS decides alone (a platform with no entries there is refused).

block_default.description: Stop the AstrBot pipeline after forwarding so the built-in LLM never double-replies in conversations owned by the agent.

forward_quoted_text.description: When someone quotes a message, send the agent the quoted text and who wrote it, where the platform provides them. Off sends only the quoted message's id.

quote_max_chars.description: Longest quoted text sent to the agent, in characters; longer quotes are cut.

max_inline_image_bytes.description: Largest image, in bytes, sent to the agent inline. Images the agent cannot fetch itself (Telegram, local files, private addresses) are inlined; a bigger one reaches the agent as the note '(sent an image)'. Keep it under the agent's VISION_MAX_IMAGE_BYTES.

outbox_enabled.description: Pull the agent's outbox and deliver what it queues: scheduled openers, the follow-up question, the excuse when the model is down. Only conversations the allowlists above still allow, and only on platforms that can send unprompted. An agent without the outbox answers 404 and is asked again every ten minutes.

outbox_wait_s.description: How long each outbox pull may wait at the agent for something to deliver, in seconds (at most 30).

connector_id.description: This AstrBot's name to the agent, which queues outbox messages by it. Empty generates one once and keeps it. Set it only to give two AstrBot hosts distinct names, never the same one.
